simple.summary: תַּעֲלֻמָּה (taʻălummâh) means a secret First listed occurrence: Job 11 6.

definitions.full: H8587. taalumah תַּעֲלֻמָּהֿ noun feminine hidden thing, secret (so, with הֿ , van d. H. Bu, הּ - Baer Ginsb); — ׳תּ what is hidden Job 28:11 ; plural construct חָכְמָה תַּעֲלֻמוֺת 11:6 secrets of wisdom , ׳תּ לֵב Psa 44:22 .
